author: James Liu
contribution_statement: I developed and integrated a reinforcement-learning system for procedurally generated osu! maps, and designed and ran a study of how practice-map diversity affects generalization. The system adapts upstream osu! and osu-framework rules and uses established PPO and recurrent-network methods.
